gloss: no days off; without a break; nonstop

definitions.gloss: no days off; without a break; working continuously without rest
definitions.explanation: The state of having no breaks, holidays, or rest days. Used to describe continuous work, operation, or effort without pause. Can describe a work schedule, a store's operating hours, or someone's relentless effort.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年中|ねんじゅう}→年中：00311_nenjuu⟧{休|やす}みなし⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Open year-round without any days off.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{休|やす}みなし⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}いた→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I worked this entire month without a day off.

examples.japanese: ⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{休|やす}みなし⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}めなければ→進める：01949_susumeru⟧⟦ならなかった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Before the deadline, I had to keep preparing without any breaks.

notes:
Combines ⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧ (rest, break, day off) and なし (without, none). A straightforward compound using the common なし suffix.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{年中|ねんじゅう}→年中：00311_nenjuu⟧{休|やす}みなし: open year-round, no holidays
- {休|やす}みなし⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: to work without days off
- {休|やす}みなし⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧: operating without days off
- {休|やす}みなし⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日々|ひび}→日々：04804_hibi⟧: days without rest

USAGE:
Often seen on shop signs and advertisements to indicate that a store is open every day (⟦{年中無休|ねんじゅうむきゅう}→年中無休：21870_nenjuumukyuu⟧ is the more formal equivalent). Also used to describe demanding work schedules or intense periods of effort. The tone can be matter-of-fact (describing a store's hours) or sympathetic/complaining (describing an exhausting workload).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{年中無休|ねんじゅうむきゅう}→年中無休：21870_nenjuumukyuu⟧: open year-round — the formal, four-character equivalent
- ⟦{無休|むきゅう}→無休：10998_mukyuu⟧: no holidays — more concise and formal
- {不休|ふきゅう}: without rest — literary, emphasizing tireless effort
